notes.title: Trials on Tatooine 1.1 Update
notes.content:
An update has been released for Trials on Tatooine!

We've added a hotkey for swapping which of the Vive controllers appears as the inactive controller inside the experience. Press [b]Ctrl+H[/b] to swap the active and inactive controllers.

So if you find yourself in Trials on Tatooine and the controller you're holding appears blue and transparent, use [b]Ctrl+H[/b] to swap it. No more having to physically swap controllers.
